MATINF supports three NLP tasks as follows. Text Classification. Given a question and its detailed description, the task is to select an appropriate category from the fine-grained category list. Question Answering. Given a question, the task is to produce an answer in natural language. Summarization. Given a question description, the task is to produce the corresponding question.
